SELECT id, process_code AS processCode, process_name AS processName, description AS description, hand_method AS handMethod, backup_filed AS backupFiled, owner_user AS ownerUser, owner_user_name AS ownerUserName FROM service_process WHERE deleted = 0
AND process_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.processCode}, '%')
AND process_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.processName}, '%')

SELECT sp.id, sp.process_code AS processCode, sp.process_name AS processName, sp.description AS description, sp.hand_method AS handMethod, sp.backup_filed AS backupFiled, sp.owner_user AS ownerUser, sp.owner_user_name AS ownerUserName FROM service_process sp LEFT JOIN service_maintenance_process smp ON sp.process_code = smp.process_code AND smp.deleted = 0 WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND smp.service_id = #{id}
